title: Refuse the merged gate while a conflict candidate lacks a verdict
action: Per D5 and D2, the gate precondition. In set_gate.rs:616 `run_gate_body`, beside the two `high_risk_advisor_refusal` call sites (set_gate.rs:701 pre-lock peek and :711 post-lock recompute, both under `if exec_component && approved`), add `conflict_review_refusal(record, lane)` with the same fail-closed shape: refuse a merged (or execution) approval when `conflict_review` is absent, when its `plan_rev` differs from the record's current `plan_rev` (a plan-rev bump therefore invalidates it — no explicit reset needed, say so in the message), or when any candidate's verdict is null — naming the unverdicted candidate ids and the fix (`bee state plan-conflicts derive` / `... verdict`). A recorded `conflicts` verdict does NOT refuse (D5 verbatim): the approval output lists such candidates under `conflicts_acknowledged` so the user approves with eyes open. Lane-only like the advisor precondition; the default record (no lane) is unchanged. Update `gate` / `state gate` help in src/generated/registry_payload.json and the catalog count. Sync the home spec docs/knowledge/areas/workflow-state/gates.md (Business Rules: the precondition, its three refusal causes, the plan-rev invalidation) and the planning skill gate step in skills/bee-planning/SKILL.md (the Gate section: derive + verdict before asking the shape/execution question; one line, pointer to the spec) — then run the regen chain because skills/ is a manifest root. Tests in state_group/tests.rs (pattern: set_gate.rs:1271 `high_risk_merged_gate_approval_succeeds_after_a_fresh_advisor_ref_is_recorded` and its negatives at :1437, :1462): absent conflict_review refuses; stale plan_rev refuses; one null verdict refuses naming the id; all verdicts set approves; a `conflicts` verdict approves and the output names it; plan-rev bump after approval flips the gate (existing) and the next approval refuses as stale; unapprove never runs the check.
